citations.assessment: The Midrash gives Azaryah and Yonatan son of Rabbi Chaggai through Yitzchak bar Marion in Chanina’s name, on the reach of harmful speech.
This is a different teaching, about Abraham and the king of Sodom. It has Azaryah and Yonatan ben Chaggai transmitting in the name of bare Yitzchak.
The witness names Yitzchak bar Marion, but pairs Zekharyah with Yonatan bar Chaggai, whereas Heilprin reports Zekharyah and Azaryah.

holds.reason: The printed transcription of Midrash Shmuel disagrees on the second transmitter. Preserve the received attribution pending edition collation.
